verdict.rationale: Bento's authentication model uses a single publishable/secret key pair via HTTP Basic auth (bento-docs-20), with no documented mechanism for issuing scoped, restricted, or least-privilege credentials specifically for an agent. The Skills docs mention general 'safety guidance for API keys' but not actual credential scoping (bento-docs-29). Missing for 10: any API/dashboard feature for creating restricted-scope keys, per-agent key issuance, or permission-limited tokens.
